fieldConvention: Each operations.facts entry is required in the reviewed design. Existing disclosure predicates are identified separately from proposed narrow extensions requiring GPT approval. OPEN is a design blocker, not a new public Availability enum.

Actual successful fresh submission: immediate facts are captured from the one real execution and its real pre/post state. Rejected/duplicate attempts never gain a synthetic payment/damage/settlement delta. Applicable current observations stay separate.

A retained terminal fact may name its resolving receipt only through an explicit native causal join. No equality of time/actor/nearby revision is accepted. Missing cause is separately NotRetained while actual terminal value may remain an authorized current observation.

For all field groups: evaluate family authority before record lookup/applicability/count/cause/value. Protected families use fixed declared keys with Withheld; no hidden counts or hidden per-record placeholders. Current operatorClockGrant does not satisfy any Player/Work/Inventory predicate.

Collection rows include only identifiers authorized by the named existing/proposed predicate. There is no total native count, hidden-count, omitted-count, has-hidden, or raw array export. Multi-record facts repeat fixed keys with authorized subject causal identity, in native/ordinal order as specified.

Costs, prospective output alternatives, fixed recipes and planned duration are descriptions/assessments, not actual-result facts. Actual booked intervals and actual reserved claims are committed state; work progress is labor actually earned.

Actual registry review03: conditional future obligations are separately typed descriptors, never facts with Immediate/Retained/ObservedCurrent. Current native remaining-work counters and real scheduled bookings describe committed state, not earned future labor.

Only authoritative post-rollback outcome is projected. A failed candidate AdvanceTo does not establish paid time, ingredients, dice or outputs. Immediate fields requiring commit are NotApplicable on a rejected rolled-back attempt.
